C1532.title: Academic Research Reveals Imminent Quantum Threat to Cryptocurrencies
C1532.summary: An academic paper indicates that the first fault-tolerant quantum computers with fast clock speeds, such as superconducting and photonic architectures, could break the 256-bit elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem within minutes.
